title: EU Council vote
summary: The Council of the EU round a table, all 27 member states. Hold a vote: country by country the seat lights up while it votes, then shows yes, no or abstain.
description: The Council of the EU as a vector illustration, 27 members round a table, one per member state. "Hold a vote" plays a whole round like the real thing: everyone back to none, then country by country in protocol order (clockwise round the table) the seat lights up while it votes, gold rings ripple out, the flag lifts and waves, and then its vote lands: the flag settles at 1.6 times its size, the table rim turns green, red or amber and a badge with a check, cross or dash pops in. At the end the outcome under qualified majority. From code, every country is an enum named after its two-letter code in lower case: none, voting, yes, no or abstain. Every person, chair, table segment and flag is a named group in the file (vlag-BE, figuur-BE, tafeldeel-BE), ready for more animation in the Rive editor.

notes: Set a vote with `vm.enum("de").value = "yes"`. The values are `none`, `voting`, `yes`, `no` and `abstain`; any other string is ignored.
`voting` is the moment of voting: the flag lifts and waves, the member pulses, gold rings ripple out of the seat and the badge shows three dots. Set the actual vote after it, for example 0.8 s later.

"Hold a vote" on this page plays a whole round like the real Council: everyone back to none, then country by country in protocol order (BE, BG, CZ ... FI, SE), which is clockwise round this table. The HTML and React code include the same round as a `holdVote()` function.
At the end the page shows the outcome under the qualified majority: at least 15 of the 27 states (55%) voting yes, representing at least 65% of the EU population. Abstaining counts as not voting yes.
The vector source is in the repository (sources/eu-council-vote/eu-court.svg), with every person, chair, table segment and flag as a named group.
